com.taziggg100.valatrene.full_description:
VALAT RENE helps operations teams organize daily work without account setup or cloud sync. Create task records, assign owners, track due windows, and keep priority work visible from the dashboard.

The app also supports container movement, supply ordering, and attendance logs, giving supervisors a practical local workspace for day-to-day business coordination.
